PLAN: Finish the proven TT boil-up sweep with one intermediate final test, then retain the best valid design.
Best is 2.952 with root 50/3/2/0.2, B 120/9.5/3.6/0.1, T 40/3/2.5/0.1, BB 100/6/7.1/0.35, TT 30/5/0.8/0.1. Reducing TT boil-up from 1.4 to 0.8 improved both recovery and cost, but 0.7 dropped TTB just below the 95% C3 blend threshold and lost about $70M/yr. Use the last solve at 0.75 to seek the limiting profitable recovery without sacrificing the blend. BB pressure gains saturated at 0.35; 0.40 was negative. BB boil-up 7.2 loses C6 purity, and lower B reflux/stages or B dp 0.2 failed. Structural additions are uneconomic. The 2.952 design remains the fallback.
